meta.notes: The tutorial's quiet mission, the ledger: a money changer's shop off a bazaar street on a snowing night, alone. One line: out of the porch lamp and along the trodden path in the lane, a man whistled from his fire round a wall the player stands behind and taken from behind for the strongroom's code, a picked back door, a man in a lit room put out from the dark with a sponge round off the rifle's launcher, a beam passed on a knee, then the mains: the clerk comes round his counter to the box in the dark and is taken at it, and the code opens the strongroom. Generated by tools/levels/tut-quiet.ts.

steps.line: Press [C] to crouch
Get out of the light
Stay in the shadows
Press [V] to whistle here, then hide behind the wall
steps.ringLine: Hold [Space] and press [5] to whistle, then hide behind the wall

steps.line: When he lights a smoke, sneak up behind him and {grab him}

explain.title: Whistle to lure a guard
explain.text:
He heard that, and he's coming to look. Stay behind the wall, out of his light.
He'll check out the sound and then stop for a smoke, with his back to you. Come around the wall, go up behind him, and {grab him}.

steps.line: Press [Space] to ask him for the code
{Knock him out}
Go to the back door
Press [Space] at the lock to pick it

explain.title: Picking a lock
explain.text:
This door is locked. Stand at the lock and press [Space] to pick it.
Picking a lock, entering a code or opening a safe takes a few seconds. If you move or press [Space] again, you stop.
The lock clicks while you work on it, and a guard close by can hear it.

steps.line: Go inside
Stay back in the dark, because there's a laser right behind him
Press [2] to take out your rifle
Press [2] again to load a sponge round
steps.setupLine: Press [2] twice to load a sponge round

explain.title: Using the rifle's launcher
explain.text:
Your rifle's launcher fires grenades that kill, or sponge rounds that knock a guard out. Look next to your ammo at the bottom left to see which one is loaded.
It says HE right now, which is the grenade. Swap it for a sponge round so you stay quiet.

steps.line: Step out to where you can see him through the doorway
Hold the right mouse button, aim at him, and let go
Press [E] to put your rifle away
Stay low and go under the laser beam
Press [N] to turn on night vision
Press [Space] at the breaker box, then hide behind the wall
Stay hidden until he's working at the breaker box, then take him from behind
Press [Space] at the keypad to enter his code
Press [Space] at the safe to take the ledger
Leave by the front door
Leave through the gate
